PR #308 is waiting on CI for its new head, `05d351d7cb`, so this session stops here.

- **Why it was red:** the earlier failing CI had run before `master` moved, so it judged an old tree. Nothing in the branch was broken.
- **What I did:** caught the worktree up to the branch on GitHub (it was 3 commits behind, missing the two audit passes), merged `origin/master` (no conflicts), and pushed.
- **NOTES:** `docs/lanes/perfarch/NOTES.md` now says why the earlier resumes found the PR in draft: the session had ended on a wait for queued soaks, not on unfinished work. It has since been audited twice and was already marked ready. The note also records this merge.
- **PR body:** the `Files:` line matches the diff, apart from the auditor's two `docs/audits/` files.
- **Still open:** once CI is green, the `needs-rebase` label comes off and `fold-ready` goes on. I posted a `[lane.perfarch] waiting:` comment saying so, and the handback job will resume me when CI finishes.

The Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorizing in claude.ai's connector settings before they can be used. This session doesn't use them.
